parts.text: As a dispatcher, I am the licensed person responsible for planning and running our flights, which includes deciding which drone flies and along which way, and signing off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and while I have the legal responsibility to choose the drone and the way it flies—since our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us—I do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and the same popular drones.
